Thursday 19 November 2026 · 23 stories
Morning Brief
Nifty 50 fell 0.63% to 25,228 and decliners led 1,851 to 711
Today’s read
The biggest names carried the session. The fifty most traded stocks returned +0.41% weighted by turnover, against -1.01% for the median stock, a gap of 1.4 percentage points, so most stocks did worse than the busiest names suggest.

Faze Three Limited rose 7.0% on 118 times its usual volume, and it was in the news with “Market Trading Guide: Deepak Fertilisers among 3 stock recommendations for Thursday”.

Indoco Remedies Limited rose 7.6% on 165 times its usual volume, and it was in the news with “Indoco Remedies share price jumps 13%; pharma stock up over 16% in 2 weeks: Can the rally extend? What experts say”.

The exchange has formally asked 1 company to explain today's move: Subros Limited. Those queries were filed after the close, so they confirm the move rather than explain it. NSE's own surveillance flagged the same names.

Nothing in the news or in exchange filings explains the volume in Vesuvius India Limited (295x), Subros Limited (176x), Ndr Auto Components Limited (116x). That usually points to a sector story rather than a company one.
